goals: Address gaps in the architectural/building-block options available in the modpack.
scope: Provide the Stone Parapet and Stone Louvered Shutter as two AMC blocks with matching items for Minecraft Java 26.2 Fabric.

Use the Macaw masonry block classes and model parents. The parapet maps vanilla Stone directly. The shutter uses the same Stone grain at matching UV coordinates, with structural lighting measured across the reference shutter's five repeated slats.

Provide Andesite, Diorite and Granite Buttons and Pressure Plates using the vanilla Stone controls, and Gothic Windows and Arrow Slits using the Macaw Stone Brick forms. Bind each material's vanilla sprite directly and preserve Macaw's glass and iron bars.

Provide Andesite, Diorite and Granite variants of BBB's Stone Column, Urn, Moulding, Fence and Frame using the provider classes, description items and original model hierarchies. Remap ten authored sheets independently for each material using its vanilla palette. Granite BBB textures use the eight interior colors of the luminance-ranked vanilla Granite palette.

Provide 13 Mud Bricks block/item pairs. Use Packed Mud directly for the two controls, four standard Macaw windows and parapet. Use Packed Mud grain with structural shading for the louvered shutter and its full palette for the five BBB masonry forms.

Provide 23 Prismarine Bricks and eight Dark Prismarine forms. Each material has vanilla controls, a Macaw louvered shutter and five BBB masonry forms. Prismarine Bricks also has five thin paths, six pavings and four engravable full blocks based on Macaw's Paths. Both louvered shutters use the finalized C9 Stone shutter artwork remapped by luminance rank to the full vanilla palette of the respective material.

Provide a Button, Pressure Plate, Parapet, Gothic Window, Arrow Slit and Louvered Shutter for Sandstone and Red Sandstone. The controls, parapets and windows use directional vanilla textures. Each shutter uses the matching vanilla top sprite on every face at the original UVs, with C9 structural shading on the five slats and frame.

Provide six Deepslate, 21 Quartz and 23 Nether Bricks forms. Use vanilla controls, Macaw's Windows geometry and interactions, and directional Deepslate and Quartz textures. The Deepslate and Nether Bricks shutter artwork uses the finalized C9 Stone shutter remapped to the full corresponding vanilla palette. Quartz and Nether Bricks each have eleven thin Macaw paths and pavings and four independent engravable full blocks with full vanilla palette transfers.

Provide 26 End Stone Bricks forms: five BBB masonry forms, fifteen Macaw paths and pavings including four independent engravable full blocks, four standard windows, a parapet and a louvered shutter. Provide one Polished Blackstone Louvered Shutter. Both shutters transfer the finalized Stone artwork to their full vanilla palettes.

Provide 15 Mossy Stone Bricks controls, masonry and window forms. Selectively moss the corresponding vanilla, BBB, Macaw and AMC Stone artwork using the vanilla moss footprint and the brightness of each source pixel.

Provide all 30 AMC forms for each of Tuff, Cinnabar, Sulfur and Smooth Basalt. Use vanilla Stone controls, BBB Stone masonry, Macaw windows and paths, and the full vanilla palettes for the four C9-derived shutters. Each material has four independent engravable full blocks.

Provide 28 optional AMC forms each for base Veradite, Mirestone and Kurodite. Enderscape retains its six polished controls. Register the three families and enable their built-in assets and data after the optional provider registers its block/item pairs.

All 30 Cinnabar forms use vanilla Cinnabar Bricks as their visual source. Direct material slots reference the brick tile and derived artwork uses its full 15-color palette. Raw Cinnabar and Cinnabar Slabs remain the recipe materials.

Provide all 30 forms for Purpur, Resin and optional Dusk Purpur. Use native Purpur and Dusk Purpur blocks and slabs. Resin uses raw Resin Blocks for crafting and stonecutting and the Resin Bricks tile for artwork. The three shutters use the complete seven-color palettes on the finalized C9 artwork.
Use the matching AMC Column cap sprite on all Purpur and Dusk Purpur Button surfaces and inventory previews at vanilla Button UV scale.

Provide all 30 forms for vanilla Calcite and optional Enderscape Block of Shadoline. Use full Calcite in slab slots and enderscape:shadoline_block_slab for the corresponding Shadoline recipes. Both shutters use the C9 Stone template and the full native material palette.
Adds six BBB-style Mossy Oak forms when Ribbits is installed.

Provide 88 optional Macaw doors using the original door classes, authored model parents, item art, crafting patterns and wood-specific material masks. Veiled and Mossy Oak have Bark Glass. Celestial and Murublight have Stem Glass.

exclusions: Additional forms and materials, provider replacement, and IBF or BGE integration are outside this release.

dependencies.reason: Supplies the base material registries and textures, Stone redstone control behavior, glass and iron bars for AMC's Minecraft Java 26.2 families.
Loads the AMC and Macaw entrypoints on Fabric.
Supplies creative tab events and access to the vanilla control constructors.
Supplies the masonry behavior classes, model parents, conditional iron bars, tags and shutter sound. Controlled reference build used Macaw's Windows 2.4.2 for 26.2 Fabric.
Provides the five masonry implementations, description items, hammer and planting behavior, family tags and shared models. The controlled build uses the retained BBB C9 for 26.2 Fabric.
Provides the path, directional paving and engraved block implementations and shared model parents. The controlled build uses Macaw's Paths and Pavings 1.1.1 for 26.2 Fabric.
Supplies five optional base materials and their slabs, and six existing polished controls. Enderscape 3.0.2 enables 144 additional AMC pairs alongside the 387 standalone pairs.
Provides Mossy Oak Planks and slabs. The six wood forms and their assets and recipes register after both Ribbits and BBB initialize. The controlled texture source is Ribbits C27.
Supplies the wood door classes, model parents, prints and interactions used with Enderscape or Ribbits. Controlled reference was Macaw's Doors 1.1.5 for Fabric 26.2.

state.milestone: C30 passed controlled checks for all 88 doors, four Enderscape/Ribbits combinations and the optional Macaw-absent configuration. Owner visual and gameplay verification and acceptance are pending.
